description: This file contains a shell script for testing various functionalities of the 'git clone' command, including different protocols, URL formats, clone options, and edge cases. It includes setup procedures, test cases with expected outcomes, and auxiliary functions for testing remote URL parsing, SSH wrappers, and partial clones.

methods.name: test_clone_url
methods.description: Performs a test clone command with specified URL and verifies the expected SSH command output.

methods.name: expect_ssh
methods.description: Verifies the SSH command used during clone matches expected pattern, depending on arguments.

methods.name: copy_ssh_wrapper_as
methods.description: Copies the SSH wrapper script to a specified filename for testing different SSH variants.
